response.justification: The candidate is a strong and versatile senior engineer, but his career centers on web/full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than the modern C++ expertise this role demands. His only dedicated C++ experience was a ~6-month stint at National Instruments a decade ago, and he shows no evidence of IEC 62443/SDL security practices, MQTT/message-broker work, or industrial automation domain experience, making him a poor match despite his overall seniority.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems
Proven high-performance/low-latency systems work (millions of HTTP requests/sec, async I/O, concurrency in DLang)
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience (brief role ending in 2015); C++ not even listed in his skills section
No industrial automation, IoT protocol (MQTT, OPC UA, Modbus), or IEC 62443 secure development background
Career trajectory increasingly focused on web/full-stack and AI tooling, diverging from this role's domain

key_factors.factor: Strong systems-level and concurrency experience (in DLang)
